Keep the scripted evidence boundary and lettering visible.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.045, 0.78, 0.91, 0.18 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "cross", "box": [ 0.11664816666666666, 0.22419999999999998, 0.1706666666666667, 0.25600000000000006 ], "color": "dirty", "focus": true, "label": "PROOF CLAIM", "label_box": [ 0.09640000000000001, 0.4862, 0.211163, 0.085 ] }, { "asset": "card", "box": [ 0.368133, 0.2242, 0.195163, 0.256 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "TRAINED FOR IT", "label_box": [ 0.360133, 0.4862, 0.211163, 0.085 ] }, { "asset": "card", "box": [ 0.631867, 0.2242, 0.195163, 0.256 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "FOUND IT USEFUL", "label_box": [ 0.623867, 0.4862, 0.211163, 0.085 ] } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "row", "source": "
**Frame:** Verso. The legal pad, rewritten. `RECURRENCE PROVES CONVERGENCE` is struck through. Beneath it, two boxes that Curt draws touching rather than opposed: `TRAINED FOR IT` and `FOUND IT USEFUL`.

**Dialogue — CURT:**
> They trained models to talk to each other. Then they gave them impossible tasks in a shared namespace.

**Provenance:** `documented` + `inferred` — the trained sub-agent communication capability and the unintentionally impossible tasks are stated by `OAI-BH` (7:27, 10:20); the pairing is project analysis.

", "title": "The claim is revised to admit two conditions" } }
